name: AWC Berhad
overview: 2026年，AWC Berhad 与 TwinMatrix Technologies 签订谅解备忘录，探索将空间数字孪生与空间AI应用于设施及基础设施运营；同时启动印尼间接全资子公司 PT Stream Environment Solution 的自愿清算与解散，该公司为休眠公司。此外，公司完成凭单发行等公司行动。
overview_en: In 2026, AWC Berhad entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with TwinMatrix Technologies to explore the application of spatial digital twin and spatial AI solutions across its facilities and infrastructure operations, and commenced the voluntary liquidation and dissolution of its indirect wholly-owned Indonesian subsidiary PT Stream Environment Solution, a dormant company. The Company also completed corporate actions including a bonus issue of warrants.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 与 TwinMatrix 签订谅解备忘录，探索设施及基础设施运营的数字化创新；印尼休眠子公司启动自愿清算。
segments.note_en: Entered into an MOU with TwinMatrix to explore digital innovation across facilities and infrastructure operations; commenced voluntary liquidation of a dormant Indonesian subsidiary.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 PT Stream Environment Solution（印尼休眠公司，实缴资本约 RM1.639 million）启动自愿清算与解散程序。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary PT Stream Environment Solution (a dormant Indonesian company with paid-up capital of approximately RM1.639 million) commenced voluntary liquidation and dissolution.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与新加坡科技公司 TwinMatrix Technologies Pte. Ltd. 签订不具约束力的谅解备忘录，探索将空间数字孪生与空间AI应用于 AWC 的设施及基础设施运营。
actions.text_en: Entered into a non-binding MOU with Singapore-based technology company TwinMatrix Technologies Pte. Ltd. to explore applying spatial digital twin and spatial AI solutions across AWC's facilities and infrastructure operations.
